Title: Why Matcha Can Give You Heartburn

Description:
Do you get a burning stomach every time you drink matcha? Unlike steeped tea, matcha is the whole leaf ground into powder — so tannins and caffeine hit your stomach at a much higher concentration.

Tannins, caffeine, and drinking it on an empty stomach are the three reasons behind the burn — and simple ways to avoid it.

Ever get a burning stomach after your matcha latte? 🍵

Matcha is the whole tea leaf, ground into powder — so tannins and caffeine hit your stomach far stronger than steeped tea. Drinking it on an empty stomach makes it worse.

Have it after a meal, keep it lighter, and cap it at two cups a day.
